END-TO-END OBSIDIAN KNOWLEDGE BASES, EIGENT COWORK DESKTOP, LOOP AUDITING & AGENTIC RL (L1 ➔ L4)
1. Open Format Knowledge Base (obsidian-skills ★53.6k): Read & write Markdown, relational Obsidian Bases & JSON Canvas diagrams natively.
2. Local Cowork Desktop (eigent ★15.8k): Execute multi-agent desktop workflows locally under Apache-2.0 without cloud desktop lock-in.
3. Loop Auditing & Cost Gate (loop-engineering ★11.8k): Run `loop-init`, `loop-audit` & `loop-cost` to bound token spend and iteration safety.
4. Real-Harness RL Fine-Tuning (microsoft/agent-lightning ★18.9k): Distill verified harness trajectories into fast domain SLMs via 3.5k-line RL.
